```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "TransferSemi", "DESCRIPTION")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(current, "visualization_github"))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Cannot locate the repository root.", call. = FALSE)
}
repo_root <- find_repo_root()
derived_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "outputs", "derived", "sim_visualization_CATE")
figure_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "outputs", "figures", "sim_visualization_CATE")
dir.create(derived_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cate_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "semi-transfer-learning", "CATE_dim8")
final_combined_file <- file.path(derived_dir, "final_combined_results.RData")
colors = c("brown3", "steelblue","steelblue1", "darkorange3", "darkgreen", "olivedrab4")
color <- c(
  "Baseline" = "#FFB3BA",                # soft pastel pink
  "Data Pooling" = "#FFDFBA",     # peach pastel

  "Oracle Trans-Lasso" = "#BAE1FF",      
  "pERM" = "#9BF6FF",                     
  "Representation Transfer" = "steelblue1",  
  "ARMUL" = "#6FA8DC",     # medium blue

  
"Late Fusion" = "#7CFC00",          # bright lawn green
"Late Fusion with Nuisance" = "#2ECC71"   # bright emerald green
)
```

# Data Preprocess


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# Define sample sizes and similarity values
sample_sizes <- c(100, 200)
similarity_values <- c(0,0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8, 1)

# Initialize a list to store the loaded data frames
combined_results <- list()

custom_labeller <- labeller(
  n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),  # Format 'n' as "n = ..."
  similarity = function(value) paste0("", value)  # Format 'similarity' as "similarity = ..."
)
for (n in sample_sizes) {
  for (sim in similarity_values) {
    folder_path <- file.path(cate_dir, paste0("CATE_", n, "_", sim))
    rdata_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
    
    for (file in rdata_files) {
      seed_val <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))))
      if (is.na(seed_val)) stop("Cannot infer a numeric seed from ", file, call. = FALSE)
      
      temp_env <- new.env()
      load(file, envir = temp_env)
      
      # Identify the data object (assumes it's called 'result' or the first non-'seed' object)
      obj_names <- setdiff(ls(envir = temp_env), "seed")
      if ("result" %in% obj_names) {
        data_obj <- temp_env$result
      } else {
        data_obj <- get(obj_names[1], envir = temp_env)
      }
      
      # Convert to a data frame, if needed
      data_obj <- as.data.frame(data_obj)
      
      # Record n, similarity, and seed
      data_obj$n <- n
      data_obj$similarity <- sim
      data_obj$seed <- seed_val
      
      combined_results[[length(combined_results) + 1]] <- data_obj
    }
  }
}

if (length(combined_results) == 0L) {
  stop("No CATE .RData inputs were found under ", cate_dir, call. = FALSE)
}
final_combined <- do.call(rbind, combined_results)

save(final_combined, file = final_combined_file)
reference_scenario <- final_combined[
  final_combined$similarity == 0 & final_combined$n == 100,
  , drop = FALSE
]
temp1 <- reference_scenario$Task1[grepl("Baseline", rownames(reference_scenario))]
temp2 <- reference_scenario$Task1[grepl("Pooled", rownames(reference_scenario))]

median_temp1 <- median(temp1[is.finite(temp1)], na.rm = TRUE)
median_temp2 <- median(temp2[is.finite(temp2)], na.rm = TRUE)
median_temp1
median_temp2
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)

# Load the processed data
load(final_combined_file)

# If method names are stored as row names, convert them to a "Method" column.
if (!"Method" %in% colnames(final_combined)) {
  final_combined <- rownames_to_column(final_combined, var = "Method")
}
patterns <- c("Para_Transfer_Tuned", "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned", "Baseline",
              "Sai_Transfer", "Net_Transfer", "ARMUL_transfer", 
              "pERM_transfer", "Pooled")

final_combined <- final_combined[
  Reduce(`|`, lapply(patterns, function(p) grepl(p, final_combined$Method))),
]
# Recode method names so that variants are combined.
final_combined <- final_combined %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    grepl("^Baseline", Method) ~ "Baseline",
    grepl("^Sai_Transfer", Method) ~ "Sai_Transfer",
    grepl("^Para_Transfer", Method) ~ "Para_Transfer_Tuned",
    grepl("^NonPara_Transfer", Method) ~ "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned",
    grepl("^Net_Transfer", Method) ~ "Net_Transfer",
    grepl("^ARMUL_transfer", Method) ~ "ARMUL_transfer",
    grepl("^pERM_transfer", Method) ~ "pERM_transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))
#final_combined = final_combined |> filter(Method != "Sai_Transfer")
# Compute the maximum MSE across Task columns for each combination of Method, n, similarity, and seed.
max_mse_data <- final_combined %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity, seed) %>%
  summarise(MaxMSE = mean(c_across(starts_with("Task")), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, 
                         levels = c("Baseline", 
                                    "Data Pooling",
                                    "Para_Transfer_Tuned", 
                                    "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned",
                                    "Sai_Transfer",
                                    "Net_Transfer",
                                    "ARMUL_transfer",
                                    "pERM_transfer")))

# For each group (Method, n, similarity), compute the whisker endpoints and filter out values outside.
# This "non_outlier_data" will be used only for setting the y-scale.
non_outlier_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    # Use a stricter threshold: coef = 1 (instead of the default 1.5)
    bp_stats <- boxplot.stats(.x$MaxMSE, coef = 1)$stats  
    lower <- bp_stats[1]
    upper <- bp_stats[5]
    .x %>% filter(MaxMSE >= lower, MaxMSE <= upper)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

non_outlier_data <- non_outlier_data %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "Baseline") ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(Method, "Sai_Transfer") ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(Method, "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
    str_detect(Method, "Para_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion",
    str_detect(Method, "Net_Transfer") ~ "Representation Transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "ARMUL_transfer") ~ "ARMUL",
    str_detect(Method, "pERM_transfer") ~ "pERM",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))
max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  filter(!Method %in% c("pERM", "Representation Transfer"))

non_outlier_data <- non_outlier_data %>%
  filter(!Method %in% c("pERM", "Representation Transfer"))
non_outlier_data$Method <- factor(non_outlier_data$Method,
                          levels = c("Baseline",
                                     "Data Pooling",
                                     "ARMUL",
                                     #"pERM",
                                     #"Representation Transfer Learning",
                                     "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
                                     "Late Fusion",
                                     "Late Fusion with Nuisance"
                                     ))
# Now, plot the boxplot using the filtered (non-outlier) data so that the y-scale is not influenced by extremes.
p2 <- ggplot(non_outlier_data, aes(x = Method, y = MaxMSE, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Method",
    y = "Mean MSE",

  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color
  ) +scale_y_log10()

# Save and display the plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_dir, "CATE_mean_mse_plot_no_outliers.pdf"),
  plot = p2,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

print(p2)

```

```{r}
mat<-final_combined %>%
  group_by(Method, similarity, n) %>%                             # 1. group by method
  summarise(across(starts_with("Task"),                # 2. for every column whose
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),           #    name begins with “task”
                   .names = "mean_{.col}")) |> filter(n==200)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
df_heatmap <- as.data.frame(mat)
df_long <- df_heatmap %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("mean_task"), names_to = "task", values_to = "value")

# Clean task labels
df_long$task <- gsub("mean_", "", df_long$task)

# Plot heatmap
methods <- c("Baseline", "Sai_Transfer", "Para_Transfer_Tuned", "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned")
ggplot(df_long |> filter(Method=="Baseline"), aes(x = similarity, y = task, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Task", y = "Method", fill = "Mean") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```



```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

methods <- c(
  "Baseline",
  "Data Pooling",
  "ARMUL",
  "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
  "Late Fusion",
  "Late Fusion with Nuisance"
)

df_filtered <- df_long %>%
  filter(Method %in% methods) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(Method,
      "Late Fusion" = "Late Fusion"
    ),
    Method = factor(Method,
      levels = methods
    )
  )
p <- ggplot(df_filtered, aes(x = task, y = similarity, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Mean of Log") +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    barwidth = 15,
    barheight = 2,
    title.theme = element_text(size = 18),
    label.theme = element_text(size = 20)
  ))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Task1" = "T1",
    "Task2" = "T2",
    "Task3" = "T3",
    "Task4" = "T4",
    "Task5" = "T5"
  )) +
  facet_wrap(~Method, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 23) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    #strip.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.5, "lines"),
    #legend.key.size = unit(1.8, "cm"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "CATE_heat_map_CATE.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 16,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)
```
